findings: The printed proof (benzecri1960_ch3.tex:618-620) cites Prop. 4 of Ch. 3 and Prop. 4 of Ch. 1 § 3 only; Ch. 1 § 3 Prop. 4 gives the direction 'w sweepable (homogeneous) ⇒ every v_i is'. The converse direction needs Ch. 1 § 3 Prop. 3 (products of homogeneous / sweepable bases are homogeneous / sweepable; isHomogeneous_piBase, isBalayable_piBase) plus the invariance of both notions under a projective isomorphism (IsProjIso.isHomogeneous_iff, IsProjIso.isBalayable_iff, new here). An omitted citation, not a falsity.

The statement inherits Prop. 4's missing hypothesis « F(w) contains no line » (OQ-168): it is carried here as in prop4_produit, so the label stays unmarked. Whether Prop. 5 itself is false without it was not examined: the notation « v_i » of Prop. 4 is not defined for the counterexample of not_prop4_simplesS_finite (infinitely many simple subvarieties).
questions: OQ-168 (OPEN): the corrected hypothesis of record; reading taken: ¬ ContientDroite (F w), as in prop4_produit.

OQ-171 (OPEN): reading of « avec les notations de la proposition 4 »; reading taken: the Chapter 1 form of prop4_produit, with « v_i est balayable (resp. homogène) » read as « B_i = s(b_i(F(v_i))) ⊆ S(n_i) is », quantified over every enumeration and every bases (the notions are independent of these choices: two choices of bases give projectively isomorphic B_i, by IsProjIso.isBalayable_iff / isHomogeneous_iff, though this independence is not stated as a separate lemma).

instances: Benzecri.BooleProjectifInstance.simplexO_prop5: the open n-simplex (simplexO_hyps4, simplexO_prop4) with bases from exists_bases_simplesS meets every hypothesis of prop5_balayable_somme, as a Lean term

Benzecri.BooleProjectifInstance.simplexO_isHomogeneous: Prop. 5 ⇐ applied: every simple subvariety of the open simplex is a line (Σ(k_i+1) = n+1 from Produit.pdim_eq), each B_i is a convex cone of R^1 avoiding O, hence at most one point of S(0) (subsingleton_ofCone_S0), trivially homogeneous; so the open n-simplex is homogeneous
Benzecri.Sphere.prop5_of_compatible: its hypotheses (Ψ, IsProjIso, every automorphism compatible) are exactly prop4_produit's conclusion, met for every w satisfying Hyps4 (in particular the simplex)
